tasks.subtask_prompt: List the files and commands that matter for the requested change. Markdown bullets only — do not edit files.
Write a short implementation plan from the survey. Name the files to touch and the checks to run afterward. No code yet.
Implement the plan. Keep the diff small. Summarize what changed under `## Files changed`.
Pause for a human to inspect the diff and test result before review continues.
Review the implementation. Use `## Blockers` and `## High-severity findings` when needed; leave both empty when the change is clean.
